paite: Huan hiaite Sialtiel tapa Zerubbabel toh tontou siampute leh Levi mite ahi uh, Jesua, Serai, Jeremia, Ezra toh;
english: Now these are the priests and the Levites who went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

paite: Amaria, Malluk, Hattus;
english: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

paite: Sekania, Rehum, Meremot;
english: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

paite: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abija;
english: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,

paite: Mijamin, Maadia, Bilgah;
english: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

paite: Semaia, Joiarib, Jedaia;
english: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah.

paite: Sallu, Amok, Hilkia, Jedaia. Hiai te siampute lak leh a unaute uh laka Jesua damlai a pipente uh ahi.
english: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chiefs of the priests and of their brothers in the days of Jeshua.

paite: Levi mite mah leng: Jesua, Binnui, kadmiel, Serebia, Juda, Mattania, kipahthugenna tunga om, amah leh a unaute.
english: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who was over the thanksgiving, he and his brothers.

paite: Bakbukia leh Unno leng, a unaute utoh, amau delhin dan suangah a om uh.
english: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were over against them according to their offices.

paite: Huan Jesuain Joiakim a suanga, Joiakimin Eliasib a suanga, Eliasibin Joiada a suanga,
english: Jeshua became the father of Joiakim, and Joiakim became the father of Eliashib, and Eliashib became the father of Joiada,

paite: Joiadain Jonathan a suanga, Jonathanin Jaddua a suanga.
english: and Joiada became the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua.

paite: Huan Joiakim dam laiin siampute a om ua, pipute inkote lupente: Seraia laka, Meraia: Jeremia lakah, Hanania;
english: In the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers’ households: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

paite: Ezra lakah, Mesullam; Amaria lakah, Jehohanan;
english: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

paite: Malluki lakah, Jonathan; Sebania lakah, Joseph;
english: of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

paite: Harim lakah, Adna; Meraioth lakah, Helkai;
english: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

paite: Iddo lakah Zekaria; Ginnethon lakah, Mesullam;
english: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

paite: Abija lakah, Zikri; Miniamin lakah, Piltai;
english: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

paite: Bilgah lakah, Sammua; Semaia lakah, Jehonathan;
english: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

paite: Joiarib lakah Mattenai; Jedaia lakah, Uzzi;
english: and of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

paite: Sallai lakah, Kallai; Amok lakah, Eber;
english: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

paite: Hilkia lakah, Hasabia; Jedaia lakah, Nethanel.
english: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.

paite: Eliasib, Joiada, Johanan, Jaddua damlaiin Levi mite, pipute inkote lupena gelh ahi uh: Persia mi Daria lal laia, siampute tohin.
english: As for the Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, there were recorded the heads of fathers’ households; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.

paite: Levi tapate, pipute inkote lupente, Kronikil laibu ah, Eliasib tapa Johanan damlai tan hiala, gelh ahi.
english: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers’ households, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

paite: Huan Levi mite hausate: Hasabia, Serebia, Jesua, Kadmiel tapa, amau delh a unaute uh, Pathian mi David thupiak dungjuiin, indan leh indan kisuin.
english: The chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers over against them, to praise and give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, watch next to watch.

paite: Mattania, Bakbukia, Obadia, Mesullam, Talmon, Akkub te kongpite sek-ina dantan kem kongkhakngakte ahi uh.
english: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates.

paite: Hiaite Jesua tapa Joiakim, Jozadak tapa damlai, Nehemia ukpipa leh Ezra siampu laigelhmi damlaia om ahi uh.
english: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest the scribe.

paite: Huan Jerusalem kulhbang latna adin a omna tengteng uah Levi mite a zong khia ua, kipahna toh, kipahthugenna leh, lasak, dakkhutbet, tumgingte leh kaihgingte toha Jerusalema amaute honpi dinga, kipahna bawl dingin.
english: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with giving thanks, and with singing, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and with harps.

paite: Huan lasamite tapate a kikai khawm ua, Jerusalem kimvela phaijang akipan leh Netophat mite khotate akipanin;
english: The sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain around Jerusalem, and from the villages of the Netophathites;

paite: Beth-gilgal akipanin leng, Geba leh Azmaveth loute akipanin: lasamiten lah Jerusalem kimvelin khotate a na bawlta ngal ua.
english: also from Beth Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had built them villages around Jerusalem.

paite: Huchiin siampute leh Levi mite a kisiangsak ua: mite leh kongpite leh kulhbangte a siang sak uh.
english: The priests and the Levites purified themselves; and they purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

paite: Huchilaiin kulhbang tungah Juda lalte ka pi toua, kipahtugen leh a hona pai pawlpi nih ka sepa; huaiah pawl khat kulhbang tungah ekvum kongpi lamah a pai ua:
english: Then I brought up the princes of Judah on the wall, and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in procession. One went on the right hand on the wall toward the dung gate;

paite: Huan amau nungah Hosai leh, Juda lalte lak a kimkhat,
english: and after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

paite: Azaria, Ezra, Mesullam,
english: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

paite: Juda, Benjamin, Semaia, Jeremia,
english: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

paite: Leh siampute tapate laka kuate hiam pengkulte toh: Zekaria Jonathan tapa, Semaia tapa, Mattaria, tapa, Mikaia tapa, Zakkur tapa, Asaph tapa;
english: and certain of the priests’ sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph;

paite: A unaute, Simaia, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Juda, Hanani Pathian mi David tumgingtheih te toh; huan a ma uah Ezra laigelhmi a oma:
english: and his brothers, Shemaiah, and Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them.

paite: Tuikhuk kongpi kiangah, a ma jawn tak uah, David khopi dohkang ah a pai tou ua, kulhbang tou paina ah, David in tunglam ah, suahlampanga tui kongpi phain.
english: By the spring gate, and straight before them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the ascent of the wall, above the house of David, even to the water gate eastward.

paite: Huan a lak ua pawl dang kipahthugente amaute tuak dingin a pai ua, kei amau nungah, kulhbang tunga, meipi insang tunglamah, kulhbang lian tanphain;
english: The other company of those who gave thanks went to meet them, and I after them, with the half of the people, on the wall, above the tower of the furnaces, even to the broad wall,

paite: Huan Ephraim kongpi tungah, kongpi lui kiang, ngasa kongpi kianga, Hananel insang, Meah insang, belam kongpi tanphain: huan venna kongpi ah a ding kinken uh.
english: and above the gate of Ephraim, and by the old gate, and by the fish gate, and the tower of Hananel, and the tower of Hammeah, even to the sheep gate: and they stood still in the gate of the guard.

paite: Huchiin Pathian in sunga kipahthugen bawl nihte leh kei, leh ka kianga vaihawmte laka a kimkhat a ding ua:
english: So stood the two companies of those who gave thanks in God’s house, and I, and the half of the rulers with me;

paite: Huan siampute, Eliakim, Maasei, Miniamin, Mikai, Elioenai, Zekaria, Hanania, pengkulte toh;
english: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

paite: Huan Maasei, Semai, Eleazar, Uzzi, Johohanan, Malkija, Elam leh Ezer. Huan lasamiten ngaihtakin, a heutupa uh Jezrahia toh la a sa ua.
english: and Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

paite: Huan huai niin kithoihna thupite a lan ua, nuam a sa uhi; Pathianin lah nuamsakna thupi toh amau nuam a sasak ngala; huchiin numeite leh naupangte toh a kipak uhi: huchiin Jerusalem kipahna gamla pi tana leng jakin a om hi.
english: They offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced; for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

paite: Huan, huai niin thohlawm te, vei thillat te, hai thak masa pente, sawmakhatte koihkhawmna dantantea heutu, danin a seh banga, siampu leh Levite tantuan kho chihin a nahihzoh bang jel ua lakhawmmi dingte a sep ua; Judate bel nasemmi siampute leh Levite jiakin a kipak mahmah uhi.
english: On that day were men appointed over the rooms for the treasures, for the wave offerings, for the first fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them, according to the fields of the cities, the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites who waited.

paite: Huan a Pathian uh indan leh siansakna indan a kem ua, huchibangin lasamite leh kongkhakngakmiten David leh, a tapa Solomon thupiak bangin a hihta uh.
english: They performed the duty of their God, and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the porters, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.

paite: David leh nidang laia Asaph dam laiin lasami heutupen leh Pathian kianga phatna leh kipahthugenna lasakte lah a om ngala.Huan Zerubbabel damlai leh Nehemia damlaiin Israel tengtengin, ni tenga a kul bangin lasamite leh kongkhakngakmite tantuan a pe jel uhi: huan Levi mite adingin a siangsak ua; huan Aron tapate adingin Levi miten a siangsak uhi.
english: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

paite: Huan Zerubbabel damlai leh Nehemia damlaiin Israel tengtengin, ni tenga a kul bangin lasamite leh kongkhakngakmite tantuan a pe jel uhi: huan Levi mite adingin a siangsak ua; huan Aron tapate adingin Levi miten a siangsak uhi.
english: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, as every day required: and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron.
